checklist: rustc --version is 1.98.1; rustc -vV says host wasm32-wasip1-threads and LLVM version 21.1.8 (the wasi-llvm it links)

corpus, compiled and run in the kernel: hello world; -O with std::fs, std::env (args, OUT), process::exit(7); a crate with a dependency (greet as an rlib, --extern) printing `hello, slicc!` and fib(25)=75025; an out-of-bounds panic; a missing source and E0308 fail with rc 1
every compiled program imports only wasi_snapshot_preview1 functions and exports _start; the corpus sizes and import sets are logged for the old-vs-new comparison

users enforce: alice compiles in her home (the output is hers), is refused bob's 0600 source (couldn't read … Permission denied) and his 0755 directory (nothing left there), compiles his 0644 source into her home; root compiles everything
test/imports.mjs (ci): rustc.wasm imports only env (shared memory), wasi (thread-spawn), wasi_snapshot_preview1 and wasix_32v1, and the list is logged for the import-set diff

test/notices.mjs (ci, 1.98.1-6, homescoop#1086): rustc.wasm carries LLVM Support code (llvm_regcomp, the regexec error string, llvm_blake3_hasher, xxh3_64bits) and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md (in files) has Henry Spencer's regex, BLAKE3 and xxHash notices, taken from wasi-llvm 21.1.8-2's share/licenses/llvm-support. 1.98.1-5: none of the three (NEGATIVE.md)

cert/hygiene.mjs (1.98.1-7, patches/0016), as alice: rustc hi.rs -o hi.wasm leaves only hi.rs and hi.wasm, as does a failed compile (homescoop#953: 0004's in-process LLD call exited before link_binary removed the *.rcgu.o objects and its rustcXXXXXX temp dir); -C lto=fat and -C lto=thin build a program that runs or fail with an error on stderr, never silently (homescoop#1237: 0016 drains the codegen's shared emitter in 0015's WASI fatal exit); no slicc.dependencies (homescoop#1087). 1.98.1-6 fails 7 of its 11 assertions

cert/heap.mjs (1.98.1-8, homescoop#1287): rustc.wasm links the malloc family wrapped by scripts/wasm-refresh-malloc.c (the view refresh); hello world's heap (HOMESCOOP_WASM_PEAK, 161 MiB) stays within the 192 MiB initial heap, and 3 rounds of rustc -O (16 parallel codegen units) of a new 400-function program under SLICC_WASM_BACKTRACE=1 exit 0, run, and give 0 wasm traps (about 280 MiB each)
